topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: I can't help but feel a bit heavy-hearted knowing you’re dealing with this discovery about your friend. It’s tough, especially when there’s been dishonesty involved. What's important now is to consider how you feel and what you need from this relationship moving forward. Sometimes, people share parts of themselves that aren’t true because they’re afraid or seeking acceptance. It might be helpful to talk to them, if you feel safe doing so, to understand why they felt the need to lie. Just remember, your feelings and well-being are important. Take the time you need to reflect and decide what’s best for you. I’m here if you want to talk more or need any support.
